from pathlib import Path
p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/lay-kar-alam-furat-say.md\")

urdu = body.strip().splitlines()
assert len(roman) == len(urdu) == 14
assert all(line.startswith(\"  \") for line in roman)
assert \"\\u200c\" not in body
print(\"14 Roman lines and 14 Urdu lines\")
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 Urdu verses in the selected lyric and verified that they match the Roman transcription line by line. Preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics` with sentence casing, added the Urdu title, kept the Roman title as `alternateTitle`, set `direction: rtl`, and removed `noUrdu`.

I rendered the ambiguous “Ammo” as `عمّو`, preserving Sakina’s spoken address.
